environments.description: A compact optimistic retro exploration starship bridge, cream curved wall panels, teal low consoles at rear left and rear right, wide rear viewport onto a quiet blue planet, empty graphite deck

A rugged military science-fiction carrier bridge, ribbed gunmetal bulkheads, recessed red and amber console lights at the perimeter, narrow rear armored viewport onto deep space, empty steel deck. No weapons

A peaceful botanical research starship bridge with sage-green hull panels, small hydroponic plant beds only along the rear wall and outer corners, side consoles, rear viewport showing a pale ringed world, empty moss-green metal floor

A lived-in cargo freighter cockpit bridge with worn ochre paneling, chunky 1970s buttons without symbols, cable bundles tucked along sidewalls, broad rear window revealing a sparse asteroid belt, empty brown-gray deck

An elegant alien starship command bridge with smooth violet curved architecture, low faceted crystalline control pedestals at far sides, broad rear oval viewport onto a lavender nebula, empty dark violet floor. No mystical runes

A airy solar-sailing spacecraft bridge, pale copper ribs and off-white shell, a rear panoramic window showing golden solar sails against space, slim low consoles at back corners, empty pale stone-colored deck
A small solitary deep-space communications ship bridge, dark blue acoustic wall panels, amber round instrument shapes without text along back wall, rear porthole with distant stars, empty navy deck

A industrial science ship bridge orbiting a dim red dwarf, charcoal walls with large orange structural ribs, side console banks with simple nonverbal light blocks, rear windows on a red planet horizon, empty slate floor

An Art Deco starliner bridge with curved walnut-colored side consoles, brass trim and deep emerald upholstered wall panels, wide rear window showing calm space, a generous empty polished dark deck. No central chair

An ice-moon expedition starship bridge, pale blue utilitarian panels, dark low consoles pushed to the side edges, rear viewport showing blue-white ice cliffs under a black sky, empty dark blue rubberized deck

A small cyberpunk gaming café interior, a row of compact unoccupied game stations against the back wall, deep blue panels and restrained cyan-magenta edge lighting, no signage, chairs tucked in along the rear, empty lower foreground floor

An intimate attic room for handheld video games, sloping timber ceiling, low shelf of simple unmarked colorful handheld consoles against back wall, rear skylight at upper-middle right, rolled cushions only at far edges, empty honey-colored floor
